 Editorial standards 
 
The AI SDR has gone from a 2023 demo to a real line item on sales budgets. An AI SDR, short for AI sales development representative, automates the grind at the top of the funnel: building target lists, researching accounts, writing personalized outreach, sending sequences, and chasing follow-ups. In 2026 the category spans fully autonomous AI sales agents, AI sales assistants that draft and enrich, AI cold calling tools, and the data and revenue-intelligence platforms that feed them. We tested the leading AI SDR tools and ranked them on real prospecting performance, data quality, and verified pricing, not on who pays us the most.
 
 
 TL;DR 
 Best autonomous AI SDR: AiSDR , runs prospecting through meeting-booking end to end. Best all-rounder / best free tier: Apollo.io , 275M+ contacts, sequences, and a genuinely usable free plan. Best for custom workflows: Clay . Best revenue intelligence: Gong . Best inbound AI sales agent: Expertise AI . No AI SDR fully replaces a human rep, use them to scale prospecting, then hand engaged buyers to people.
